name: Voxel Hash for Gaussian Splat Indexing
aliases: Voxel Hash Map for Splat Indexing
definition: A data structure that maps each 3D Gaussian Splat to the voxel cell containing its center μ, enabling efficient lookup of splats within specific voxel regions for operations like carving or stacking.
summary: Voxel Hash is a sparse data structure that maps 3D Gaussian Splats to voxel cells, distinguished by its direct bidirectional mapping for rapid splat identification and modification.
